title: [BUG] Shift + Tab not appearing, repeated permission requests for same file
body:
## Environment
- Claude CLI version: 0.2.99 (Claude Code)
- Operating System: macos 15.4.1 (24E263)
- Terminal:  iTerm2

## Bug Description
I have Max subscription.
Shift + Tab no longer appears to be working. Even within the same file, it repeatedly asks for permission to make edits.


## Steps to Reproduce
1. Run claude code and ask for a prompt

## Expected Behavior
- Shift + Tab to appears as option for Yolo. 
- Avoid repeatedly requesting permission for the same file.


## Actual Behavior
- No Shift + Tab

## Additional Context
Max subscription
